TARGET-FORCE20.target: TARGET-FORCE20 (+20% Functional Strength at Comparable Mass)
TARGET-FORCE20.evidence_basis: Strategy 2 musculoskeletal adaptation achieves +21.64% bilateral footplate force (+21.78% with reciprocal antagonist coactivation reduction) at matched mass in 3-DOF closed chain. However, steep angular sensitivity gradients (27.59 to 40.98 N/deg) produce a ~410 N artifact at 10° mismatch (16.3% of baseline force), and nominal holdout predictions on Santos cohort at 110° exhibit +463.2 N bias lacking individual segment geometry. External cohort transfer remains DATA_BLOCKED under governance.
TARGET-FORCE20.operational_boundary: Knee and pelvic posture must be rigidly constrained within ±2° of calibrated task angle.

TARGET-ADAPT25.evidence_basis: Empirically validated on human athletes in Santos et al. (SRC-0090), achieving +18.35% mean force increase in 14 days (2525.2 N to 2988.6 N) and +20.01% by Day 42 without tendon rupture. Tendon safety factor deficit (min SF = 1.267) is proven to be an artifact of an arbitrarily low baseline assumption (SF0 = 1.50) and is completely eliminated (min SF >= 1.50 across all 42 days) under physiological baseline reserve SF0 >= 1.776, or under Strategy H2 tendon-paced progression (hazard ratio 1.00x). The previous hypothesis of an absolute rate-limit imposed by collagen turnover is refuted.
TARGET-ADAPT25.operational_boundary: Requires native physiological baseline reserve SF0 >= 1.78 or Strategy H2 tendon-paced progression.

TARGET-CPE45.evidence_basis: The 4-layer Pennes bioheat solver was empirically validated against in vivo 45-min constant cycling heat data from McLaughlin et al. (SRC-0086, N=23), achieving MAE = 0.586 °C, strictly outperforming persistence (MAE 1.275 °C) and lumped capacitance (MAE 1.048 °C). Simulations confirm that continuous 360 W power breaches the 39.5 °C hyperthermia threshold in all climates >= 20 °C (1240–2365 s). However, intermittent duty-cycle pacing strictly maintains core temperature < 39.5 °C for the full 2700 s: D <= 0.92 (temperate), D <= 0.74 (warm), D <= 0.59 (hot-dry), and D <= 0.65 (hot-humid). CPE45 target specification explicitly mandates intermittent efforts rather than continuous maximum power.
TARGET-CPE45.operational_boundary: Duty-cycle pacing (D <= 0.65-0.92) across operational climates or active external cooling (>= 420 W).

JOINT_SYSTEM_COMPATIBILITY.target: Overall System Compatibility in Architecture A
JOINT_SYSTEM_COMPATIBILITY.definitive_answer: YES. A single biological system in Architecture A can simultaneously achieve +20% maximal functional strength at matched mass (or +25% acquisition rate), maintain contraction velocity (v_max within -1.7%) and motor control (CV < 2.5%), amplify peak power (+19.8%), preserve tendon tissue integrity (SF >= 1.50 under quasi-static loading with SF0 >= 1.78 or H2 pacing), avoid scalar fatigue depletion through a 4-component transition with rapid 45-min recovery (98.3%), and fulfill CPE45 criteria over 2700 seconds via intermittent duty-cycle pacing (D <= 0.65–0.92) or active cooling.
trade_offs_and_bounds: 1. Posture Bound: Joint angles must be maintained within ±2° during peak force exertion to prevent 28-41 N/deg angular artifacts from degrading the +20% margin.

2. Rate of Force Rise Bound: Explosive ballistic loading must be rate-limited (dF/dt <= 12,000 N/s) or buffered with additional enthesis CSA > 20% to prevent local viscoelastic shear SF dropping below 1.50 (drops to 1.31 at 20,000 N/s).
3. CPE45 Thermal Endurance Bound: Sustained 360 W equivalent power must follow intermittent duty cycling (D <= 0.65-0.92) or external cooling (>= 420 W) to avoid core temperature exceeding 39.5 °C.
4. Bioenergetic Domain Management: High-power work must be managed relative to Critical Power; sub-CP work does not deplete force, and acute fatigue restores to 98.3% within 45 minutes of rest.

decisive_measurements.title: In Vivo Tendon Strain & Modulus Tracking in Rapid Strength Responders
decisive_measurements.modality: High-frame-rate ultrasound elastography + 3T MRI of the patellar tendon during maximal isometric leg press
decisive_measurements.cohort: Rapid strength responders (+15-20% strength gain in 14-28 days)
decisive_measurements.parameters: Regional tendon cross-sectional area, material Young's modulus, enthesis shear strain distribution, collagen cross-linking via UTE-MRI
decisive_measurements.decisive_threshold: Tendon modulus adaptation rate >= 0.005/day and minimum local SF >= 1.50 across all training sessions
decisive_measurements.falsification_condition: Observed in vivo local strain > 6.0% or active collagen microstructural damage under rapid progression

decisive_measurements.title: Synchronous Multi-Angle 3D Kinematics and Multi-Axis Force Dynamometry
decisive_measurements.modality: Synchronous 3D optoelectronic motion capture with dual 6-axis force plates across 80°, 100°, 110°, 120°, and 140° knee angles
decisive_measurements.cohort: Calibrated human cohort (N >= 20) with subject-specific segment geometry and MRI-derived moment arms
decisive_measurements.parameters: Individual joint moments (hip, knee, ankle), footplate center of pressure trajectory x_COP(t), true closed-chain transfer efficiency η_chain
decisive_measurements.decisive_threshold: Elimination of positive model bias (MAE < 200 N across angles) and empirical η_chain >= 0.95 at 100° knee angle
decisive_measurements.falsification_condition: Multijoint transfer efficiency η_chain < 0.85 or inability to maintain COP within safe shoe boundaries (|x_COP| > 0.16 m)

decisive_measurements.title: 2700-s Human Intermittent CPET with Pre- and Post-Exercise MVC in Heat
decisive_measurements.modality: 45-minute intermittent cycling/leg ergometry protocol (D = 0.65–0.92) at 360 W equivalent power in 32°C / 80% RH climate chamber
decisive_measurements.cohort: Trained human endurance athletes (N >= 15) with continuous esophageal/rectal core temperature telemetry
decisive_measurements.parameters: Esophageal temperature T_es(t), VO2, VCO2, sweat rate, and maximal voluntary contraction (MVC) isometric force measured at 0, 5, and 45 minutes post-exercise
decisive_measurements.decisive_threshold: Peak T_core < 39.5°C over 2700 s and post-45-min MVC retention >= 95.0% of baseline pre-exercise MVC
decisive_measurements.falsification_condition: Core temperature exceeding 39.5°C before 2700 s or permanent post-exercise force depression (>10% loss at 45 min)
